INTRODUCTION
Department of Education provides students with a unique experience of academic life with a strong focus on research and career development. The department has an impressive spectrum of expertise within the field of Education with a faculty that has wide-ranging research and teaching interests and abilities.
Students gain a clear and comprehensive understanding of the professional field through various practices. Once graduated the graduates are eagerly sought after by prestigious organizations. The department takes every possible step to facilitate its students to acquire academic and professional excellence and to become outstanding members of society
In short, the Department of Education prepares its graduates as change agents, instructional leaders, educational managers engaged in the improvement of pedagogical practices. Furthermore, it prepares them to face the challenges of the 21st century and to be compatible with the rest of the world.
VISION OF THE DEPARTMENT
The Department of Education in AWKUM was established in 2009. The introduction of B.Ed and M.Ed programs were conceived by the Administration from the very first day. Keeping in view the needs and aspirations of people across the region, M. Phil program has also been started by the department. The vision of the department is to provide trained professional and teacher in the field of education along with a skilled researcher. This department focuses on the pre-service teacher education that entails the use of modern technology and teaching strategies in the profession of teaching as well as in the area of educational research. This Department of Education strives hard to develop the intellectual, moral, professional and academic capabilities of the youth and would further channelize their intrinsic energies towards the attainment of cherished goals.
